title.zh: 机场付费周期陷阱：为什么绝不建议新手直接购买小机场多年付套餐？
title.en: Subscription Term Traps: Why You Should Never Buy Multi-Year Plans from Niche Proxies

cluster.zh: 性价比与永久套餐选购集群

description.zh: 从机房运营生命周期、资金时间价值与沉没成本风险三个维度，深入剖析小机场两年付/三年付背后的资金盘逻辑，树立科学健康的订阅消费观念。
description.en: A strategic guide analyzing the financial risks of multi-year proxy subscriptions, detailing host cash-flow failure cycles, sunk cost fallacies, and optimal subscription tenures.
